paragraphs.text: Samson desires to wife a daughter of the Philistines of Timnath; and this of the Lord, for an occasion against them, Jud 14:1-4. His parents go down with him to Timnath: a young lion meets him; he kills it, Jud 14:5-7; in his return he findeth honey in the carcass, Jud 14:8,9. Keepeth a marriage feast: hath thirty companions adjoined to him; to whom he propoundeth a riddle; with promise of a present, Jud 14:10-15. His wife extorts from him the explication, and discovereth it, Jud 14:16-18. He slayeth thirty Philistines of Ashkelon, and therewith payeth his present, Jud 14:19. His wife is given to another, Jud 14:20.
